description: Search NASA's own library of photographs, video and audio: everything on images.nasa.gov, from the Apollo landings to this week's launch. Find material by subject, keyword, NASA center, photographer, place or date; get any item with a ready-to-use link at every size from thumbnail to full resolution; read what is in an album; pull a video's transcript as text; and see how a photograph was taken, down to the camera, lens and exposure. No account or API key is required.
